info.name: API Reference Associated Persons Enrolment Intents API

params.name: status
params.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `processing`, `scheduled`, `action_required`, `addon_selection_required`, `pending_confirmation`, `enrolling`, `enrolled`, `not_undertaken`, `ineligible`.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

items.docs: Returns a list of `enrolment_intents`. The `enrolment_intents` are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recent `enrolment_intent` appearing first.

Creates a new `enrolment_intent` to manage the enrolment of an employee into a group. An enrolment intent represents the intention to enrol an employee into a specific group, and tracks the status and progress of that enrolment process.

Updates the policy configuration for an existing `enrolment_intent`. This will reset the enrolment intent back to `processing` status and re-evaluate the enrolment intent based on the new configuration provided.Unavailable for enrolment intents that are already `enrolling` or `enrolled`.

info.name: List requirements for an enrolment intent

params.name: object_type
params.description: Filter by object type (employee or employer)

params.name: object_id
params.description: Filter by object ID (employee ID or employer ID)

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of adaptive requirements for an `enrolment_intent`. Requirements must be fulfilled before enrolment can proceed.
Confirms an `enrolment_intent` that is in `PendingConfirmation` status. This transitions the enrolment intent to `Enrolling` status and initiates the enrolment process with the insurance provider.
Rejects an `enrolment_intent` that is in `PendingConfirmation`, `ActionRequired`, or `AddonSelectionRequired` status. This transitions the enrolment intent to `NotUndertaken` status.

info.name: Submit coverage selections for an enrolment intent

items.docs: Submits plan coverage option selections for an enrolment intent in the `addon_selection_required` status.

info.name: Create a dependents management intent for an enrolment intent

items.docs: Creates a dependents management intent as a sub-intent of an enrolment intent. The enrolment intent must be in `pending_confirmation` status.
